notes.title: Update v1.07.4
notes.content:
•	Added the ability to call tamed companions to the player’s location. The Default Key to do this is [C].

•	Tweaked and Improved Enemy ranged combat. 

•	Removed the ability to reassign the Escape key, because this can have game breaking consequences to menu.

•	Fixed a physics bug on a few Fortress Objects. This was especially urgent for ladders.   

•	Optimised the Generation and Loading of Chunks slightly.

notes.title: Update v1.07.4
notes.content:
•	Added the ability to call tamed companions to the player’s location. The Default Key to do this is [C].
•	Tweaked and Improved Enemy ranged combat. 
•	Removed the ability to reassign the Escape key, because this can have game breaking consequences to menu.
•	Fixed a physics bug on a few Fortress Objects. This was especially urgent for ladders.   
•	Optimised the Generation and Loading of Chunks slightly.

notes.title: Update v1.07.3
notes.content:
•	Fixed a bug that caused weapons to fall through the ground.
•	Fixed an issue with NPC ranged attack targeting.

notes.title: Update v1.07.2
notes.content:
•	Closing the Inventory with items left in the Crafting Window will now automatically move all of the items straight to the Inventory and close it straight away. 
•	Fixed the floaty mouse camera movement.  
•	World Chunks now load one at a time to help improve performance.
•	During melee combat the crosshair in the center of the screen now changes depending on the situation.  If you have a clear target lined up and can hit them, it will change to a small Trident Icon.  If you are successfully blocking your target, it will change to a small shield icon.
•	Improved Hesicasial’s hair texture.

notes.title: Update v1.07.1
notes.content:
•	Altered the collision on Tormented Souls to include their head. 
•	Fixed a problem that was causing Mountains to sometimes still intersect with forts.
•	Made it far more likely to find a stick near a tree.
•	Reduced the amount of Devil Fortresses that generate in the world.
•	Set the link to the How to Play video to disable the music so that it doesn’t play over the video.

notes.title: Update v1.07
notes.content:
•	Added 2 new mobs.  The Imp and the Shoo-Man Demon.  The Shoo-Man Demon replaces the Hell Boar, which is now removed from the game.
•	Hellgoats can now eat Plasma Fruit Plants.
•	Increased how often mobs spawn.
•	Increased how many mountains generate.
•	Increased the chances of Plasma Fruit Plants spawning in the environment. 
•	Created the ability for the Player and NPC’s to get damaged by fire just by touching it, whether actually on fire or not. 
•	Added Brimstone Blocks, which can be ignited and burn for a long time. 
•	Changed the amount of time that all Brimstone objects catch on fire and burn for.  10 minutes for Ore Veins and Blocks. 5 minutes for pieces of Ore.
•	Increased the amount of Brimstone Ore that spawns in the environment. 
•	Brimstone Ore Veins no longer randomly catch fire mid day as too many objects burning for long periods of time causes long term performance issues.
•	Allowed player made objects to be placed on enemy building structures.  This is handy for candles when mining them down at night or if you are actually daring enough to attempt to live in an enemy building. 
•	Made much better looking and more optimised lava geyser FX for the Lava Geyser Rock Formation.
•	Made Loot Bags Heavier, so they don’t fly off as easily. This was especially a problem with Imps dropping them.
•	Updated the Tutorial Pages.
•	Fixed a problem that was preventing NPC’s from breaking windows. 
•	Fixed a problem that may have been causing NPC’s to not walk up stairs.
•	Fixed a bug that was causing spiders to tilt when on fire. 
•	Fixed an issue that was preventing objects from being moved around properly while placing them.
•	Fixed a problem with the Plasma Fruit Plant Distance Material. 
•	Fixed a bug that was preventing spiders from climbing up blocks. 
•	Fixed a bug that prevented terrain from generating objects if there was a Fortress on it. 
•	Added the Ability for Spiders to bust through windows. 
•	Improved the Ambient Hell Background Sound Effects.
•	Optimised the Tormented Soul AI when chasing targets.
•	Optimised the Fire FX on all Brimstone objects and Wooden Blocks.

notes.title: Update v1.06.1
notes.content:
•	Fixed some issues with the world generation. 
•	Fixed a bug that was preventing NPC’s from moving towards Noxious Plants. 
•	Fixed a physics issue with the loot bags.

notes.title: Update v1.06
notes.content:
WARNING – This update will most likely break your current saved game. My Apologies.

•	Added a poisonous plant that shoots gas at nearby creatures and drops Wax when destroyed for making candles. 
•	Added craftable Candles, that can be held for portable light and placed on horizontal surfaces.
•	Added a droppable silk gland when harvesting dead giant spiders.  This can be crafted into string for making candles. 
•	Adjusted the location of the ladder in the tall towers of 2 of the Enemy Fortresses. 
•	Slowed the sprint speed down for the Hellhound, player and devils slightly.  
•	Added rare spawning Tombstones in the environment generation as locations for the New Death mob to spawn.
•	Added Death (the Grim Reaper) that will spawn at night at his tombstone and vanish again when the sun comes up.  Death is a neutral character and will not attack unless he is attacked. Killing Death will cause him to drop some of his bones that can be used to craft Epic items. 
•	Added the craftable Epic Deathbone Equipment:  Pickaxe, Axe, Hammer, Trident and Armour components.  
•	Added a Recipe Book screen accessed via the Inventory that lists all items that can be crafted from the player’s inventory.
•	Added a Time of Day and Night bar to the UI.  
•	Prevented Chunks exhausted of objects from regenerating new objects where there are player made objects on it to help with performance and preventing too many objects to load. 
•	Added a normal map to the Magicka potion liquid for the cauldrons found in Forts to give it some detail. 
•	Added visual damage to Rock and Ore. 
•	Improved the Plasma Fruit material.
•	Fixed an issue with some distant model materials.
•	Fixed an Issue with the Mountain Colliders.
•	Fixed a bug that was causing Giant Spiders to walk on thin air.
•	Fixed a bug that was causing the player’s camera to get stuck at crouch height. 
•	Fixed an exploit bug that occurred when the player was on a Ladder while mining it.  
•	Fixed a bug that allowed the player to automatically pick up their dropped items when they died.  
•	Fixed bugs with and Improved and Optimised the AI.
•	Made various performance optimisations. 
•	Stopped goats from spawning on mountains, since they usually fall to their death too often or get killed by giant spiders. 
•	Increased the chances of Giant Spiders spawning on mountains.
•	The Candle, The Landmark sign and most of the Furniture had the wrong save script on them. That has been fixed, but will break current saved games. 


ATTENTION: This update will break current saves.  If you are very concerned about losing your building progress, I can rescue your saved game if you upload your world’s save folder somewhere where I can download it and post the link to it in the Fallen Angel: Hell Survival community.  BUT YOU NEED TO MAKE SURE YOU DO THIS BEFORE YOU LOAD AND SAVE YOUR GAME AGAIN AFTER THE GAME HAS BEEN UPDATED.  Otherwise it will be too late to fix.  The Fallen Angel Save Folders should be located in;  [Drive Letter]:\Users\[YourUserName]\My Games.  You will need to send the files and folders of your current save from both the Worlds and Entity folders. Make sure they remain in that structure so that there is no mix up. Or just send me your whole Fallen Angel game folder and tell me which world name needs rescuing.

notes.title: Update v1.05.1
notes.content:
•	Fixed a problem that caused saved harvestable corpses to fall through the world when loading a saved game. 
•	Fixed a problem where the LOD distance card representation of an enemy fortress would be visible while the player was close to or inside the fortress when a saved game was loaded. 
•	Adjusted the height of the Lava trigger as it was too low. 
•	Fixed a footstep timing sound effect issue on the player.
•	Fixed a problem on some 4 legged beasts with the landing sound happening when it should not be happening and the walking sounds not working when they should be working. 
•	Prevented the player from spamming crouch too fast, which can cause the camera to get stuck at the wrong height.
•	Fixed a problem that was preventing Mobs from seeing and detecting building blocks.
•	Optimised Building blocks with simpler materials over distance LOD’s. 
•	Optimised AI Enemy seeking. 
•	Increased the amount of Magicka given from Magicka sourced objects like Cauldrons and Magicka Wells from 50 to 100.
•	Brimstone Ore Veins will now randomly catch fire in the middle of the day.

notes.title: Update v1.05
notes.content:
•	Added Lootable Potions:  Potion of Cure Poison, Potion of Healing and Potion of Restore Magicka
•	Added Potion Cabinets (Lootable), Alchemy Tables, Cauldron Magicka Sources (Drink to get magicka), Wooden Tables and Chairs to enemy fortresses.
•	Added Creepy Organic Magicka Wells that randomly spawn in the environment for filling up your Magicka. 
•	Added extra Craftable Furniture; Sofa, Short table, Throne, Barrels (Inc. Labelled versions, Rocks, Coal, Iron, Brimstone, Titanium), Wardrobe and a Chest of Drawers. 
•	Loot bags updated with potions replacing less interesting items in the random result.
•	Added 2 Stone shards and 4 Sticks near the player when they start a new game to help them get started. 
•	Added gameplay tips when attempting to mine an object with empty hands and attacking an enemy bare handed.
•	Changed the loading screen. Added a progress loading bar and a new backdrop.
•	Added random game play tips to the loading screen. 
•	Added a Respawning Loading Screen.
•	Optimized Spawning and Despawning of saved Chunk Objects to help prevent Freezes while moving around the world.

notes.title: Update v1.04.1
notes.content:
Update v1.04.1

•	Reduced the mining time of enemy building components. 
•	Bug Fix - Offset the Hellhounds teleport to player to fix a bug that can cause the player to get pushed through the terrain.
•	Increased the coexistence distance of enemy buildings for better performance.
•	Removed Mouse Smoothing.
